content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 indicates this service is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; the case provides no coding error or evidence supporting separate payment. Prior authorization is not required, and neither an authorization request nor a medical-necessity review addresses the stated bundling issue. The contractual denial cannot be shifted to the patient merely because a deductible remains, and there is no secondary payer or supported recovery path.","action":"write_off"}
